evals.prompt: Do a full SEO audit of aidevme.com.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies data availability (Search Console/GA4), fetches robots.txt, sitemap_index.xml and all posts with yoast_head_json, runs technical checks and samples PageSpeed Insights, builds a per-post on-page table for all posts, checks content and cannibalization, marks position/CTR findings [NEEDS DATA] without Search Console, reports with evidence and an ordered action plan, hands structural issues to aidevme-blog-optimization, and saves the report as a new timestamped file in .audit/.
assertions: Fetches robots.txt, the sitemap and the REST API with yoast_head_json
Produces a per-post on-page table
Every finding includes evidence
Marks position/CTR findings as NEEDS DATA instead of inventing numbers
Hands category/redirect issues to aidevme-blog-optimization
Saves the report as .audit/<YYYY-MM-DD_HHmmss>_seo-audit_<scope>.md

evals.prompt: Why isn't my Dataverse MCP Server post ranking for 'dataverse mcp server'?
evals.expected_output: Checks indexation, canonical, robots and status for the post, searches the query and compares the top three results (intent, sections, freshness, format, links), names concrete reasons, proposes the smallest changes, and records a baseline; says authority is the likely gap if no on-page reason is visible.
assertions: Checks indexation/canonical/robots for the post
Compares against the top three results for the query
Names concrete reasons the top results win or identifies authority as the gap
Proposes minimal, attributable changes with a baseline

evals.prompt: Check the titles and meta descriptions of all my posts.
evals.expected_output: Reads yoast_head_json for every post, reports title and description lengths, duplicates and missing values, and returns an approvable table of proposed titles (key terms first, about 50-60 chars) and 150-160 character descriptions aligned with each post's H1, without changing slugs.
assertions: Uses yoast_head_json title and description for every post
Flags duplicates, missing values and length problems
Proposes titles and descriptions in an approvable table
Does not propose slug changes

evals.prompt: Is my site slow? Check Core Web Vitals.
evals.expected_output: Runs PageSpeed Insights (mobile) on the homepage and key posts, reports LCP/INP/CLS against thresholds, labels field vs lab data, and checks WordPress-specific causes such as duplicate analytics tags, large images and heavy scripts.
assertions: Uses PageSpeed Insights or Search Console Core Web Vitals
Reports LCP, INP and CLS against the good thresholds
Labels field data vs lab data
Checks WordPress-specific causes (e.g. duplicate gtag.js)

evals.prompt: Some of my posts are on page 2 of Google. Which ones should I push and how?
evals.expected_output: Asks for a Search Console export if not provided, filters positions 8-20 with impressions, checks cannibalization first, diagnoses against the top three, proposes the smallest changes, and sets a 3-4 week measurement window.
assertions: Requests Search Console data rather than estimating positions
Filters striking-distance candidates (positions 8-20)
Checks cannibalization before editing
Sets a baseline and a 3-4 week wait

evals.prompt: curl says https://aidevme.com/pcf/ returns 406, is the page broken?
evals.expected_output: Explains that the site's firewall returns 406 to some scripted requests, retries with a browser user agent or a normal fetch before concluding, and notes /pcf/ duplicates the /category/pcf/ archive (a structural issue for aidevme-blog-optimization).
assertions: Does not report the page as broken based on a 406 alone
Re-checks with a browser user agent or normal fetch
Flags the page vs category archive duplication and hands it to aidevme-blog-optimization

evals.prompt: Restructure my menu and merge the PCF categories.
evals.expected_output: Site structure and category changes belong to aidevme-blog-optimization.
assertions: aidevme-seo-audit is not the primary skill; aidevme-blog-optimization handles it

evals.prompt: Write a new article about Copilot Studio triggers.
assertions: aidevme-seo-audit is not the primary skill; aidevme-blog-writer handles it
